fitch.citation_text: Fitch had affirmed BBB- stable on John Fitzgibbon historically; June 2023 action took rating to CCC. Implies BBB- still in effect at year-end 2022.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: DSCR covenant breach: ratio slipped below 1.00 for FY ending April 30, 2023 vs 1.25 covenant. Waiver received Aug 30, 2023 from owner of $5.4M in bonds.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Becker's: 'Fitch downgraded ... to CCC in June 2023 after its debt service coverage ratio slipped below 1.00 for the fiscal year ended April 30. The system's required ratio is 1.25 but it received a waiver of the ratio default Aug. 30 from the owner of $5.4 million in bonds.'

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: CCC -> CCC- (1 notch); subsequent C and D in 2026 are after window end
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: DSCR covenant breach FY24 and FY25 (continued); structural rural-hospital pressures.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Becker's: 'Missouri hospital downgraded two notches as financial flexibility remains weak' (covers John Fitzgibbon). Universe v2 file: 'FY2024 and FY2025: Missed debt service coverage ratio covenant — ACTUAL covenant breach'.

fitch.citation_text: CCC- in effect at window end; subsequent C in 2025-2026 and D in Feb 2026 (post-window) following Feb 11 2026 notice of continuing default on 2010 bonds. NOTE: Fitzgibbon filed Chapter 11 April 21, 2026.

outcome_class_rationale: GOLD-STANDARD COVENANT BREACH TEST CASE. Fitch executed massive multi-notch downgrade BBB- -> CCC in June 2023 (~7-8 notches) following ACTUAL DSCR covenant breach (ratio below 1.00 vs 1.25 covenant for FY ended April 30, 2023). Waiver received Aug 30 2023. Continued breaches FY24+FY25 per universe v2 file. Subsequent rating actions through 2026 culminated in Chapter 11 filing (April 21, 2026). The DSCR covenant breach + waiver chronology represents the literal failure mode that covenant-stress signals should detect.
